A biblioteca reúne arquivos aprovados po: The library contains files approved by an administrator. The company recorded in the DLIS, service provider and collection are different fields. The publisher confirms the organization; discrepancies require review. Uploading one file does not authorize sharing other files.
O visualizador decodifica frames em arra: The viewer decodes frames into numeric arrays. Each point records the file SHA-256, logical file, frame and channel keys, sample index and component index (zero-based). Hover readings and exports access these arrays. Numbers are never recovered from the image.
A profundidade cresce para baixo. A unid: Depth increases downward. Points retain the original unit, explicitly converted to meters on the axis. Each track can have its own frame and depth channel. No samples are created between frames or across gaps. If automatic selection is ambiguous, choose the channel in “Configure tracks”.
A curva CBL é vermelha (#FF0000). Referê: The CBL curve is red (#FF0000). The free-pipe reference and thresholds must suit the tool and file. Without explicit parameters, there is no automatic classification. You can enter a manual reference and amplitude/reference ratio limits. Manual and automatic classifications are kept separate.
Waveforms usam escala de cinza. O AGC no: Waveforms use grayscale. AGC normalizes each row for display only; raw values remain unchanged. Time in microseconds appears only when a compatible time channel is associated and its correspondence confirmed. Otherwise, the axis displays the component index.

−2000: sem leitura, verde #008000. Outro: −2000: no reading, green #008000. Other negatives: gray #808080.
Essas zonas de impedância não constituem: These impedance zones alone are not a universal assessment of cement quality. Azimuths are not artificially distributed over 360°. Micro-debonding requires an explicitly identified flag; an image with this name is not itself a YES/NO flag.
A leitura é feita no navegador com uma a: Reading takes place in the browser using a conservative adaptation of the RP66 V1 parser. Encrypted records, nonnumeric representations and incomplete metadata may prevent a frame from being plotted. The interface explains the reason. Compatibility with every file or proprietary extension is not guaranteed. Large files depend on available browser memory.
Salve a análise na sua conta para recupe: Save the analysis to your account to recover points when reopening the same SHA-256. CSV and JSON preserve the JavaScript numeric representation of decoded data. Excel numeric cells are limited to 15 significant digits; prefer JSON for precision auditing. Empty cells represent unavailable data.
